_comment: The association's calendar. ONE row per event, both languages side by side, exactly
like i18n/strings.json — same reason: a Spanish event that quietly loses its English
is the failure this shape exists to prevent.
This file is a BOX, not a form. Every field has a hard length range and i18n/events.py
refuses to load the file if any of them is out of range, so `python3 i18n/build.py`
fails rather than rendering a card that is taller than the one beside it. The ranges
are what make every card identical, which is the whole point of the wheel.
To add an event, read .claude/skills/multitec-events/SKILL.md in the management repo:
it is the procedure for turning a poster, a WhatsApp forward or an Instagram caption
into one of these rows. Then run:  python3 tests/test_events.py
PLACEHOLDER DATA, 2026-08-31: the four past rows are real Multitec events with dates
reconstructed from the site and the press section; the four upcoming ones are
plausible inventions so the section can be looked at. Every one of them needs Sergio
to confirm or replace it before this reaches main.
